entrySequence.contract: Character accept stores request fields, sets Menu+1 true at0x59b11f, crossfades music95 at0x59b146 and prepares public loading image. It does not initialize Game or Level.
Menu Update runs fade before selected child. While startRequested, f32 startFadeAlpha +=0.025f32 at0x59b2ab..0x59b2b8. This does not depend on device audio time.
Character Update reads Menu+1 and compares alpha>=1 at0x59d0aa..0x59d0c0. If reached, it normalizes the public seed and requests System new run at0x59d218 via0x594620.
Stores character/challenge/seed/mode arguments, then sets System+0x2f2c8 true at0x594672.
Next System Update calls0x594a10 at0x595108 before menu/game dispatch. Thus a request raised by menu child is consumed on the following System Update.

If pending run, destroys old menu, initializes Game if needed, sets System state2 at0x594a62, calls Game new run0x54eb20 at0x594ab8, then aligns an odd System counter upward at0x594bf0 and clears pending at0x594aef.
Resets run seeds, pools and actual player/Level initializers. Calls Level generation0x58be30 at0x54ec47.
After successful floor generation and start/current/previous descriptor assignment, loads starting room via0x586c90 at0x58c357. Calls that actual Room Music at0x58c36a; no fitted music delay.
Stage music uses actual Game stage+0 and alternate byte+4, read0x5c4bfd..0x5c4c09. Starting room descriptor asset stage0 is a special-room catalogue identity and is not the stage music selector.

Music controller advances channels before consuming queued ID. If previously stopped95 receives floor queue on loader phase, that phase prepares floor at age0; subsequent dispatches advance its ages. Natural backend completion remains host-clock dependent.
